target_buyer.why_top_candidate: Family-owned for 50 years, serves 8 counties (Lake, Geauga, Ashtabula, Trumbull, Mahoning, Portage, Stark, Cuyahoga) plus northern PA. No subcontractors — all employees. Has own welding/fabrication shop. Strong established brand with clear service areas.

actual_brand_research.logo_observed: Circular fence graphic with 'THOMAS FENCE CO' text, established/traditional styling
key_services: Residential fencing (wood, vinyl, aluminum, chain link)
Custom swing gates, cantilever gates, overhead slide gates
actual_brand_research.service_area: Lake, Geauga, Ashtabula, Trumbull, Mahoning, Portage, Stark, Cuyahoga counties (OH) + northern Pennsylvania
actual_brand_research.company_tagline_observed: Fence Company Ashtabula Ohio / Fence Contractor Northeast Ohio
key_differentiators_from_site: Design, build and install full line of fencing
actual_brand_research.visual_style: Traditional, established, professional, green color scheme conveys outdoor/nature connection, American flag in header photo shows patriotism/local pride

brandkit_for_mvp.proposed_tagline: 50 Years of Fencing Excellence — Now With Instant Online Quotes
brandkit_for_mvp.positioning: The digital extension of Thomas Fence Co.'s 50-year legacy — bringing their no-subcontractor, employee-only craftsmanship to modern online scheduling and quoting across 8 Ohio counties and northern PA.

typography_recommendation.heading_font: Use existing Thomas Fence brand fonts (maintain 50-year brand equity)

visual_direction.hero_image_concept: Aerial shot of completed fence project (like on current site) with service area map overlay showing 8 counties
visual_direction.color_scheme: Maintain existing green/white established brand colors
visual_direction.photography_style: Professional fence installation photos, crew at work, completed projects, American flag element for local pride

implementation_recommendations.brand_alignment: MUST use actual Thomas Fence green colors (#228B22) and existing logo — do not invent new branding
key_features_needed: Fence type selector matching Thomas Fence offerings (wood, vinyl, aluminum, chain link)
Custom gate/kennel inquiry form for fabrication shop
Property line/permit guidance (integrate with County Building Dept)
